content:
Marissa wants to complete the 12-mile trail with an average speed of 4 miles per hour. This means the total time for the hike must be:

Total time = Total distance / Average speed = 12 miles / 4 mph = 3 hours.

She has already hiked for 1 hour (first 4 miles) + 1 hour (next 2 miles) = 2 hours.

So, she has 3 - 2 = 1 hour left to finish the trail.

The remaining distance is 12 miles - (4 miles + 2 miles) = 6 miles.

To cover 6 miles in 1 hour, she needs to walk at a speed of 6 miles per hour.

Answer: 6
